# Contributing

## Report an issue

Include reproduction steps, the expected result, and your Studio, Windows and OBS versions. For a visual issue, attach a minimal exported profile and a screenshot. Keep connection tokens private.

## Submit a change

Follow the [development guide](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) to build and verify the application.

- For protocol and schema changes, check saving, migration, backups and reconnecting.
- For editor changes, check Undo/Redo, keyboard interaction and small windows.
- For analog device support, provide the model and hardware identifiers.

Analog HID support builds on AnalogSense implementations. Component credits and licenses are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
